Treatments/prompts from docs/redesign/04-LIVING-SCENES-HANDOFF.md Part 3; real-asset overrides from §1.5c. status: pending -> drafted -> generated -> selected -> encoded -> live.

beats.prompt: Locked-off camera on a tripod, zero camera movement. Inside a pitch-dark garage a car sleeps under a taut fabric cover, lit by one low warm tungsten key. Animate atmosphere only: fine dust motes drifting slowly through the warm pool of light, a single subtle breath of air moving across the fabric cover, the warm practical light breathing very slightly in intensity like an old filament. Everything else frozen. Film-noir grade: deep matte-black shadows stay fully crushed, desaturated graphite palette, warm highlights only, subtle 35mm film grain, shallow anamorphic depth of field. The clip must end on exactly its first frame.
beats.negativePrompt: no camera push, pan or drift; the cover never slips or reveals the car; no new light sources; no lens flares; no blue or teal color shift; no text, logos or people; no warping of floor, wall or cover geometry; no exposed wheels or grille
beats.qa: cover silhouette must not swim; blacks must not lift

prepImage.prompt: Recreate this photograph exactly — identical composition, camera position, framing and light: a near-black private supercar garage just before dawn, one car asleep under a fitted fabric cover, a single faint warm tungsten pool low on the polished concrete floor, vast negative space and stillness. Upgrade the execution to flawless large-format photorealism: real automotive-cover fabric with visible weave and natural drape tension over the silhouette, crisp concrete micro-texture and subtle reflection inside the light pool, true deep blacks with detail held at the edge of visibility, subtle 35mm film grain, desaturated graphite palette with warm highlights only. No text, no logos, no people. This is the opening and closing frame of a film — museum-grade restraint.

beats.prompt: Locked-off tripod camera, zero camera movement, straight-on to the industrial door. The steel sectional door rises slowly and steadily through the entire clip — one continuous mechanical motion at constant velocity, slats curling away at the header, no pauses, no bounce. The horizontal blade of warm tungsten light beneath the leading edge widens from a thin slit into a tall glowing doorway, its reflection stretching and blooming down the wet asphalt toward the lens. As the door clears, the corridor beyond is revealed: a one-point-perspective hallway, one warm ceiling fixture glowing in the near run and a second barely visible at the vanishing point, dim, warm, sharp and still. The air stays clear — no fog, no haze; only the light widens. Film-noir grade: crushed matte-black night, desaturated graphite palette, warm tungsten highlights only, subtle 35mm grain.
beats.negativePrompt: camera movement, camera push, pan, shake or zoom; fog, smoke, haze or mist; people; vehicles; hands; door panel warping, wobbling or bending; slats changing count or thickness; readable text, signage or logos; flicker or strobing; blue or teal color shift; lens flares; brightening of the night sky; interior over-exposing or blowing out

beats.qa: door leading edge straight across all frames; slat count constant; corridor reveal must match Plate B geometry; asphalt reflection tracks the blade, not swims

prepImage.prompt: Recreate this photograph exactly — identical composition, camera position, framing and light: a dead-straight-on symmetric night view of a private garage entrance, camera at standing eye height on the centerline, a wide industrial sectional door in matte graphite steel filling most of the frame, precision-machined horizontal slats with flush seams, slim brushed-steel guide rails and drive hardware in the side reveals catching warm rim light, a thin horizontal blade of warm tungsten light escaping beneath the bottom edge with its reflection stretching down wet asphalt toward the lens, dark board-formed concrete around the opening, a single small warm downlight above the lintel. Upgrade the execution to flawless large-format photorealism: real brushed-metal and powder-coat micro-texture on the slats, crisp board-formed concrete grain, physically accurate wet-asphalt reflection of the light blade, true deep blacks with detail held at the edge of visibility, deep focus with everything sharp, subtle 35mm film grain, desaturated graphite palette with warm tungsten highlights only. beats.prompt: Smooth, stabilized first-person point of view gliding forward at a calm walking pace — camera at standing eye height, starting exactly at the first frame's position on the centerline, several strides from the open industrial doorway, moving straight toward and through it. Steadicam-smooth: no bob, no sway, no shake; the gaze locked on the vanishing point ahead. As the camera crosses the threshold, the steel doorframe slides past the edges of frame and the cold night falls away behind; warm light wraps the frame; the corridor's ceiling fixtures pass overhead, their reflections sliding down the polished concrete underfoot. Over the final two seconds the glide accelerates toward the vanishing point — the space itself pulling you in — yet the image stays composed and sharp to the last frame, ending mid-glide on a clean, readable corridor frame. Film-noir grade: crushed matte-black shadows, desaturated graphite palette, warm tungsten highlights only, subtle 35mm grain.
beats.negativePrompt: head bob, footstep bounce, handheld shake, camera sway; hands, arms, feet, body parts or a walking shadow; vehicles or car parts; people; the door closing or moving; camera turning, looking around, tilting or reversing; stopping; heavy motion blur or smeared frames at the end; text or signage; strobe flicker; blue or teal shift; wall, slat or floor geometry warping; lens flare streaks; fog or smoke
beats.post: all-intra encode for scrubbing; SEPARATE mobile trim ending on the calm pre-acceleration glide (coarse pointers play once and hold); reject takes ending on smear — last frame must be composed and sharp
beats.qa: frame 0 must be pixel-identical to door-industrial-open.png (= SB-02 scrub-end hold frame, invisible cut); no bob/judder under slow scrub; wall and slat geometry must not churn at frame edges; final second accelerates but stays composed

prepImage.prompt: Continuity edit. Take the first reference photograph and make one single change: the industrial door is now fully OPEN — every slat retracted up and out of sight, leaving a clean rectangular aperture framed by the guide rails. Through the aperture, seen in correct linear perspective from this exterior camera position, a garage corridor recedes to a vanishing point centered in the doorway: the corridor walls continue the door reveals inward, one warm ceiling fixture lit in the near run, a second barely visible far ahead, long darkness between them, warm reflections pooling down the polished concrete centerline. Match the second reference photograph's lighting logic and palette — warm tungsten in deep blackness — not its framing. Keep the corridor slightly underexposed: a warm glowing volume that pulls the eye inward, swallowed by darkness before it fully resolves. Everything outside the aperture stays pixel-identical to the first reference: camera, framing, night exterior, wet asphalt with its light pool now widened into a tall doorway reflection, grade, grain. This is a continuity frame for a film: any change in framing, geometry, lighting logic or grade is a failure. STRICTLY AVOID: vehicles, people, text, logos, cool or blue light, motion blur inside the corridor.

beats.prompt: First-person POV camera already moving fast down a dark garage corridor toward the vanishing point — continuous forward rush for the entire clip at constant high speed, never slowing, never stopping. Walls and concrete columns streak past with heavy horizontal motion blur; the single warm ceiling light fixture sweeps overhead and exits frame top while another dim fixture appears far ahead; warm reflections smear along the polished concrete floor. Slight hood-mounted camera micro-shake. The corridor is endless — no door, no wall, no destination visible. Film-noir grade: crushed matte-black shadows, desaturated graphite palette, warm tungsten highlights only, subtle 35mm grain, anamorphic motion-blur character.
beats.negativePrompt: no visible vehicle parts, hands, steering wheel, wheels or grille; no text or signage on walls; no people; no camera reversal, stop or speed change; no strobe flicker; no blue/teal shift; no wall or floor geometry warping

Velocity now lives in SB-02b's final-second acceleration. Assets retained in renders/SB-03 and public/videos/experience for a one-commit revert.

beats.prompt: Static locked-off tripod shot, zero camera movement. A parked graphite Audi S8 sedan, rear three-quarter view, late golden hour in high desert. The car is a statue: body panels, wheels, tires, badges, taillight graphics, glass and paint reflections remain perfectly still for the entire duration. Only the environment breathes: faint heat shimmer rising from the sun-warmed dirt behind the car, a few backlit dust motes drifting slowly through the warm raking golden light, desert scrub on the far hillside stirring almost imperceptibly in a light breeze, long shadows holding steady. Restrained luxury automotive documentary. Warm single golden key against deep shadow, subtle film grain, desaturated graphite palette with warm highlights. Seamless loop: the final frame must match the first frame exactly.
beats.negativePrompt: no camera motion, no wheel rotation or spoke morphing, no grille/panel warping, no added text, license-plate or badge hallucination, no people, no birds, no new light sources, no color/exposure pumping

beats.prompt: Locked-off static side-profile shot of a parked Audi S8 at dusk, camera absolutely still. From darkness, a single warm low key light sweeps steadily and continuously from the nose to the tail along the car's flank, progressively revealing a heritage red, white and black diagonal racing livery on the bodywork. The light's leading edge blooms softly on the paint; specular highlights travel across the doors and rear quarter; then the entire car settles fully lit and holds motionless, matching the final frame exactly. The car never moves: wheels stationary, panels rigid, livery graphics locked to the body like vinyl. Film-noir dusk grade: deep matte-black shadow, restrained warm highlights, subtle grain, no lens flare.
